by: papers_past ingest (fork of integrator-9d788fb), step 8.6; appended at its merge
title: One row of the old news-scraping database's dump, section public.scraper_results, whose news_url is a Papers Past article (paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/<PAPER><YYYYMMDD>.<n>.<n>[.<n>…])

recognise.content_type: application/gzip (a PostgreSQL plain dump, COPY text format)
landmarks: the line 'COPY public.scraper_results (id, link, post_date, scrape_date, title, news_url, author_id, raw_content, update_date, text_content, error, airtable_record_id, airtable_sync_date, is_english, pipeline_source, pipeline_status) FROM stdin;'
a row's news_url host paperspast.natlib.govt.nz and path /newspapers/ then the article id
not: a row of any other host (counted by its host, never decoded)
a row whose URL path is not an article id (a page, an issue, a search)

signals_note: The dump is held whole on node2 (124 GiB, sha256 in its own dump.sha256) and streamed per batch by registers.papers_past.capture; nothing is fetched.
notes: Seen 2 November 2026 on the first ten thousand Papers Past rows of the dump: pipeline_source MIGRATION on all; 952 MIGRATION_ERROR rows hold no text; raw_content repeats text_content; post_date is the issue date at midnight. Searched, never mined (hard limit 17): no person, claim or name is read from the text.
